issues.description: Lecture constructor parameter order mismatch: The problem statement (UML and instructions) requires the Lecture constructor parameters to follow the UML order: (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The solution repository defines the constructor with a different parameter order: (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This inconsistency will confuse students who implement the constructor following the UML/instructions and may cause tests or example usage to fail or be unclear.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the constructor declaration in the solution to match the UML and problem instructions: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign fields accordingly. Ensure the template, solution, and any tests/examples consistently use this same parameter order to avoid confusing students.
